definitions.explanation: A predetermined or fixed amount or quantity of something.
Relating to or involving the measurement of quantity, as opposed to quality. Used in scientific and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{定量|ていりょう}の{水|みず}を{飲|の}む。
examples.english: I drink a fixed amount of water every day.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}は{定量|ていりょう}を{守|まも}って{服用|ふくよう}してください。
examples.english: Please take the medicine in the prescribed amount.

examples.japanese: {定量|ていりょう}を{超|こ}えると{品質|ひんしつ}に{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Exceeding the fixed quantity affects quality.

examples.japanese: {定量|ていりょう}{分析|ぶんせき}で{成分|せいぶん}の{割合|わりあい}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: We investigated the proportion of components through quantitative analysis.

examples.japanese: {定量|ていりょう}{的|てき}なデータに{基|もと}づいて{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: We make decisions based on quantitative data.

examples.japanese: この{研究|けんきゅう}では{定量|ていりょう}{的|てき}な{手法|しゅほう}と{定性|ていせい}{的|てき}な{手法|しゅほう}の{両方|りょうほう}を{用|もち}いた。
examples.english: This research used both quantitative and qualitative methods.

notes:
Composed of {定|てい} (fixed, determined) + {量|りょう} (quantity, amount). Has two main uses: (1) a set or prescribed amount, and (2) the concept of "quantitative" in scientific and analytical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定量|ていりょう}を{守|まも}る: follow the prescribed amount
- {定量|ていりょう}{分析|ぶんせき}: quantitative analysis
- {定量|ていりょう}{的|てき}: quantitative (adjectival form)
- {定量|ていりょう}{調査|ちょうさ}: quantitative survey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定性|ていせい}: qualitative (the counterpart to {定量|ていりょう})
- {適量|てきりょう}: appropriate amount
- {分量|ぶんりょう}: quantity, dose (of ingredients or medicine)
- {数量|すうりょう}: quantity, number (general counting)
